runs.text:
City lights bleed into the tide
I keep your signal on my side
Neon hums a quiet tune
Coastline glowing under the moon

Hold the line, hold the line
Every echo answers back in time
Nova Sonder is an independent recording artist. Blending analog warmth with modern production, their releases have quietly built a devoted following.
